capabilities: Render a life-in-weeks grid from a birth date and life expectancy
Define planning phases by age range or date range
Filter and toggle phase categories inside the calendar
Mark events from inline code block config or vault notes with frontmatter
Open linked event notes from the calendar
disambiguation: Not a scheduling or daily-notes calendar; it renders a memento mori life-in-weeks grid inside notes, one row per year of age.
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README runs entirely locally with no network requests or telemetry, and includes release-packaging guidance aimed at developers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize a lifespan week by week alongside planning phases and dated life events.
summary: Life-in-weeks calendar renderer that draws completed weeks, planning phases, and linked events from life-calendar code blocks in notes.
